title: Google Quantum AI: Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation
headline: Our best graded entry scored 33.17 on 22 November, 123rd of 3,583; it is the best public entry, shared by many teams, and the leader is at 33.74. We are now testing our own ideas to pass it.
